page.title: System Operations
page.subtitle: Platform maintenance and diagnostic tools. Each action includes a description of what it does and when to use it.

resetCache.title: Reset Cache
resetCache.description: Clears all platform in-memory caches. Cached settings, catalog data, and other computed values will be reloaded from the database on next access.
resetCache.scenario: Use after direct database changes, configuration updates, or when cached data appears stale.
resetCache.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to reset all platform caches? This may temporarily affect performance while caches are rebuilt.
resetCache.successMessage: Platform cache has been reset successfully.

restart.title: Restart Platform
restart.description: Gracefully restarts the platform application. All active user sessions will be interrupted and background jobs will be paused until restart completes.
restart.scenario: Use after installing or updating modules, applying configuration changes that require restart, or resolving platform issues.
restart.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to restart the platform? All active sessions will be interrupted and background jobs paused.
restart.timeoutError: Platform did not respond within expected time. Please check manually.

sampleData.title: Install Sample Data
sampleData.description: Discovers and installs sample data packages (demo catalog, customers, orders) into the platform for evaluation and testing purposes.
sampleData.scenario: Use when setting up a new environment for demos, development testing, or evaluating platform capabilities. Avoid on production environments.
sampleData.confirmMessage: Install "{name}"? This will add demo content to your platform.
sampleData.successMessage: Sample data import has been started. Check the push notifications for progress.

backup.title: Export Platform Data
backup.description: Creates a backup of platform data including selected modules, settings, security, dynamic properties, and binary assets as a downloadable ZIP file.
backup.scenario: Use before major updates, environment migrations, or as a regular backup strategy. Select specific modules or export everything.

restore.title: Import Platform Data
restore.description: Restores platform data from a previously exported ZIP backup file. Select which modules, settings, and data to import.
restore.scenario: Use to restore from a backup, migrate data between environments, or replicate platform configuration.
restore.uploadPrompt: Drag a .zip backup file here or click to select
restore.uploadError: Invalid file. Please upload a .zip backup file.
restore.author: Author

downloadManifest.title: Download Manifest
downloadManifest.description: Downloads complete platform diagnostic information as JSON, including platform version, license details, installed modules, OS info, and .NET runtime version.
downloadManifest.scenario: Use when filing support tickets, documenting environment configuration, or comparing environments side by side.

downloadPackage.title: Download Package JSON
downloadPackage.description: Downloads a vc-package.json file listing all installed modules with versions and module sources. This file can be used to replicate the same module set on another environment.
downloadPackage.scenario: Use when cloning an environment, setting up CI/CD pipelines, or documenting the module stack for deployment.

moduleSequence.title: Module Load Sequence
moduleSequence.description: Displays the dependency-resolved loading order of all installed modules. Modules are shown in the exact sequence they initialize during platform startup.
moduleSequence.scenario: Use when debugging module initialization failures, understanding dependency chains, or troubleshooting startup errors.
